description:
Render or apply a template using one of two engines. The `engine` field selects the engine and the `action` field selects the operation:

- `engine:'filesystem'` — kObsidian's built-in `{{variable}}` substitution; no Obsidian plugin required. Actions: `render` (return the expanded text) or `create-note` (write a new note from the template).
- `engine:'templater'` — delegate to the Templater Obsidian plugin via the Local REST API. Requires OBSIDIAN_API_URL and OBSIDIAN_REST_API_KEY. Actions: `render` (execute the template and return output), `create-note` (execute and write to `targetFile`), or `insert-active` (insert into the currently active note in Obsidian).

The `filesystem` engine is pure text substitution — it does NOT evaluate Templater's `<% … %>` scripts. Use `engine:'templater'` when you need dynamic evaluation.

Operates on the session-active vault (see `vault.current` — selectable via `vault.select`) unless an explicit `vaultPath` argument is passed, which always wins.

Examples:

Example 1 — Render a filesystem template to text (no file written):
```json
{
  "engine": "filesystem",
  "action": "render",
  "templatePath": "Templates/daily.md",
  "variables": {
    "date": "2026-04-24",
    "topic": "kObsidian release planning"
  }
}
```

Example 2 — Create a new note from a filesystem template:
```json
{
  "engine": "filesystem",
  "action": "create-note",
  "templatePath": "Templates/daily.md",
  "targetPath": "Journal/2026-04-24.md",
  "variables": {
    "date": "2026-04-24"
  }
}
```

Example 3 — Use Templater to create a note via the Obsidian plugin:
```json
{
  "engine": "templater",
  "action": "create-note",
  "templateFile": "Templates/meeting.md",
  "targetFile": "Meetings/Kickoff.md",
  "openFile": true
}
```

inputSchema.description: Discriminated union on `engine`. The `action` field then selects the operation within that engine. `filesystem` supports `render` and `create-note`; `templater` supports `render`, `create-note`, and `insert-active`.

action.description: Secondary selector; valid combinations are listed under `engine`.

activeFile.description: When true, requires an active file in Obsidian (default true).

engine.description: Selects the input shape. `engine=filesystem`, `action=render`: requires `templatePath`; accepts `variables`, `filename`, `vaultPath`. `engine=filesystem`, `action=create-note`: requires `templatePath`, `targetPath`; accepts `variables`, `vaultPath`. `engine=templater`, `action=render`: requires `templateFile`; accepts `targetFile`. `engine=templater`, `action=create-note`: requires `templateFile`, `targetFile`; accepts `openFile`. `engine=templater`, `action=insert-active`: requires `templateFile`; accepts `activeFile`.

filename.description: Optional filename hint that can be referenced in the template as `{{filename}}`.

openFile.description: Open the newly-created note in Obsidian.

targetFile.description: When `engine=templater`, `action=render`: Where the rendered output should land; omit for a dry render. When `engine=templater`, `action=create-note`: Path of the note to create from the Templater template.

targetPath.description: Path where the new note should be written.

templateFile.description: When `engine=templater`, `action=render`: Path of the Templater template file.

templatePath.description: When `engine=filesystem`, `action=render`: Vault-relative path of the template markdown file.

variables.description: When `engine=filesystem`, `action=render`: Map of `{{var}}` placeholders to replacement strings.

name: templates.use

outputSchema.description: Freeform object. The specific shape depends on the tool; see the tool description.
